BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Local Government.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to regulating exterior cladding materials; adding a new section to chapter 35.21 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 35A.21 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 36.01 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) Except as provided in subsection (3) of this section, a city is prohibited from requiring or excluding exterior cladding materials that are in compliance with the state building code.
(2) "Exterior cladding" means a nonload-bearing material attached to the exterior of a building.
(3) The limitation in this section does not apply to homeowners' associations governed by chapter 64.38 RCW and plat communities governed by chapter 64.90 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 2. A new section is added to chapter 35A.21 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) Except as provided in subsection (3) of this section, a code city is prohibited from requiring or excluding exterior cladding materials that are in compliance with the state building code.
(2) "Exterior cladding" means a nonload-bearing material attached to the exterior of a building.
(3) The limitation in this section does not apply to homeowners' associations governed by chapter 64.38 RCW and plat communities governed by chapter 64.90 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 3. A new section is added to chapter 36.01 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) Except as provided in subsection (3) of this section, a county is prohibited from requiring or excluding exterior cladding materials that are in compliance with the state building code.
(2) "Exterior cladding" means a nonload-bearing material attached to the exterior of a building.
(3) The limitation in this section does not apply to homeowners' associations governed by chapter 64.38 RCW and plat communities governed by chapter 64.90 RCW.
